cases.question: I was looking at the table, but I couldn't see anything on the laptop. What was the laptop screen showing?
options: A. A photo of a person
B. A cooking tutorial
C. A calendar
D. A floral arrangement
E. A food recipe
cases.answer: A. A photo of a person

cases.question: I was watching the flowers on the table, but I didn't see the laptop screen clearly. What is on the laptop screen?
options: a photo of a person
a video of cooking
a picture of a cat
a drawing of a house
a video of a person eating
cases.answer: a photo of a person

cases.question: I was at the table with my friends, but I didn't see the flowers in the vase on the left. What was the arrangement of the flowers?
options: The flowers were in a white vase.
The flowers were in a green vase.
The flowers were in a black vase.
The flowers were not visible.
The flowers were in a blue vase.
cases.answer: The flowers were in a white vase.
cases.comment: 题目问花的“排列方式”，但选项实际区分的是花瓶颜色；问答目标错位，内部一致性不应满分。

cases.question: I was sitting at the table with my friends, but I didn't see the flowers on the table. What was the color of the flowers?
options: The flowers were pink.

options: a photo of a person

cases.question: I was looking at the table, but I couldn't see the flowers clearly. What was the other person doing?
options: The flowers were in the middle of the table.
The other person was sitting in a chair.
The flowers were in a vase.
The other person was holding a phone.
I was looking at the flowers.
cases.answer: The flowers were in a vase.
cases.comment: 题目问“另一个人在做什么”，答案却是“花在花瓶里”，答案类型与问题不匹配，且选项混合人物动作与物体状态。

cases.question: I was looking at the laptop screen, but I didn't see the photo. Where is it located?

cases.question: I was watching the flowers on the table, but I didn't see the laptop screen. What was on the screen?

a cooking recipe

a video of a person
a flower arrangement
cases.answer: an open laptop
cases.comment: 题目问屏幕内容，答案“an open laptop”不是屏幕内容；evidence 明确显示屏幕上是人物照片，答案与证据直接矛盾。

cases.question: I was sitting at the table with my friends, but I didn't see the flowers on the table. What was the flower arrangement like?

options: the pink roses on the left

cases.question: I was looking at the table, but I couldn't see the flower arrangement on the left side. What was the other person doing?

cases.question: I was looking at the table, but I didn't see the exact items laid out. What was still on the table?
